verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Giulio Mongeri and completed in 1922, the Art Deco Maçka Palas building was conceived as a private residence of distinction

verified_facts.text: The hotel's spaces feature curated works of art including photography by Ara Güler.
verified_facts.excerpt: enriched by carefully curated works of art including photography by Ara Güler

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Nişantaşı, where boutiques, restaurants and galleries are steps away.
verified_facts.excerpt: an intimate retreat at the heart of Nişantaşı, where the city's finest boutiques, restaurants and galleries are steps away

verified_facts.text: Dolmabahçe Palace, the Bosphorus waterfront and Maçka Park are within minutes of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dolmabahçe Palace, the Bosphorus waterfront and Maçka Park are within minutes, alongside the districts of Beşiktaş and Taksim.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have French balconies with views across the Nişantaşı rooftops and, in select suites, towards the Bosphorus.
verified_facts.excerpt: French balconies frame views across the rooftops of Nişantaşı and, in select suites, towards the Bosphorus.

verified_facts.text: Select suites feature a private Turkish hammam, a steam room and Dornbracht rainfall showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Select suites feature a private Turkish hammam, a steam room, and Dornbracht rainfall showers.

verified_facts.text: The Palazzo Suite has a private terrace with views of both the city and the Bosphorus.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows and a private terrace open onto views of both the city and the Bosphorus.

verified_facts.text: The Palazzo Suite includes a billiards table.
verified_facts.excerpt: A billiards table completes the suite's sense of private, residential living.

verified_facts.text: Cipriani Istanbul is within the hotel and serves Venetian cuisine, including Carpaccio, Bellinis and Pappardelle Cipriani.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu honors the enduring traditions of Venetian cuisine, from Carpaccio and Bellinis to the celebrated Pappardelle Cipriani.

verified_facts.text: Cipriani Istanbul has mahogany walls, marble floors and the Cipriani aquarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mahogany walls, marble floors and the brand's signature leather chairs create a setting of timeless elegance, completed by the iconic Cipriani aquarium

verified_facts.text: The Lobby Lounge sits beneath the hotel's glass atrium.
verified_facts.excerpt: set beneath the hotel's glass atrium where natural light filters through the afternoon

verified_facts.text: The Lobby Lounge serves loose-leaf teas, sweet and savory bites and cocktails with live harp and cello music each afternoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: an exceptional selection of loose-leaf teas from around the world, sweet and savory delights and signature cocktails are served to the gentle accompaniment of live harp and cello music

verified_facts.text: Nusr-Et Maçka Palas is a steakhouse within the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nusr-Et Maçka Palas brings the celebrated steakhouse experience to the heart of Nişantaşı, within Park Hyatt Istanbul – Maçka Palas.

verified_facts.text: Kapicciiiinoo, Nusret Gökçe's first coffee concept, is located within the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kapicciiiinoo, Nusret Gökçe's first coffee concept, is located within Park Hyatt Istanbul – Maçka Palas in the heart of Nişantaşı.

verified_facts.text: Kalimera Istanbul serves Aegean cuisine with fresh seafood, traditional mezedes and handmade Greek desserts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal ingredients sourced from Greece inform a menu built around fresh seafood, traditional mezedes and handmade Greek desserts

verified_facts.text: Roof Bar 805 is an open-air bar on the eighth floor with views towards the Bosphorus.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched above the rooftops of Nişantaşı on the eighth floor of Park Hyatt Istanbul – Maçka Palas, Roof Bar 805 offers one of the neighborhood’s most distinctive open-air settings. Views extend towards the Bosphorus

verified_facts.text: The Spa offers Turkish hammam rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Be sure to experience our unique Turkish Hammam rituals that blend tradition with modernity.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a 24-hour gym equipped by Technogym.
